newsitem.title: UK: Jan Ekofisk loadings delayed five days - traders.
newsitem.headline: Jan Ekofisk loadings delayed five days - traders.

text.p: Loadings scheduled under the original January Ekofisk programme have been delayed by around five days, but there are no cancellations, equity holders said on Thursday.
The last of the remaining January cargoes has been given Feb 5-7 loading dates.
"It's roughly a delay of five days," said one equity holder.
First loadings under the February programme, due to be released on Friday, are expected towards the end of the first decade of the month, he said.
Production at the 350,000 barrel per day North Sea Ekofisk field restarted around midday on Tuesday after a one week unscheduled shutdown due to a gas leak in an oil pipeline.
Field operator Phillips Petroleum declared force majeure on crude loadings at its Seal Sands terminal the day after the shutdown.
The original January Ekofisk loading programme scheduled 31 cargoes making a total of 16.6 million barrels against a December total of 14.77 million.
